title: PoP updated
description: An operator edited a PoP relay's name, expiry, budgets, limits or guest settings (R74, docs/76). The event names the PoP and nothing else about it: never an address, a pairing string or a credential. The `data` of a `fi.ioio.gawk.pop.updated` CloudEvent.

pop.description: The PoP the operator acted on: the Pop resource's name.

displayName.description: The PoP's name as shown to people, after the edit.
